traits.zh: 临窗可赏河面波光与农田绿意
traits.en: Window seats offer river and farmland views

traits.zh: 咖啡豆来自埃塞俄比亚、洪都拉斯等地
traits.en: Beans sourced from Ethiopia, Honduras, etc.

traits.zh: 座位极少，主要为站立式吧台
traits.en: Very few seats, mostly standing bar

traits.zh: 清晨时段常有护士和跑步者光顾
traits.en: Nurses and runners frequent early mornings

focus.zh: 座位少且不适合久坐办公
focus.en: Few seats, not for long work

energy.en: Few seats, mainly for quick drinks
